subject: RE: FW: BRUSSELS AIRPORT - YYZ / 169 CRATES 1,314 KGS
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote your cheapest air freight option from HAM to JFK (New York, US)? Our buyer in New York is importing the goods from us in Germany, and we are arranging the flight for this import shipment.

The printed marketing material will be ready on 2026-11-28. We will deliver the shipment to HAM ourselves. There are 12 pieces with a gross weight of 485 kg and a total volume of 1.34 cbm.

Please quote an all-in price in EUR for this import. Please attach the offer to your reply as a PDF, as our purchasing department needs it for filing.

Thank you.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-10-02
Subject: BRUSSELS AIRPORT - YYZ / 169 CRATES 1,314 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex BRUSSELS AIRPORT to YYZ:
